$$=\left|\left[\dfrac{x^4}{4}-\dfrac{7x^3}{3}+5x^2\right]_0^2\right|+\left|\left[-\dfrac{x^4}{4}+\dfrac{7x^3}{3}-5x^2\right]_2^5\right|$$

$$=\left|5\dfrac13-0\right|+\left|10\dfrac{5}{12}-\left(-5\dfrac13\right)\right|=5\dfrac13+15\dfrac34=21\dfrac{1}{12}\text{ sq units}$$

When fully repaid $A_n=20000\times1.004^n-\dfrac{320(1.004^n-1)}{0.004}=0$

$20000(1.004)^n=80000(1.004^n-1)$, so $60000(1.004)^n=80000$, $(1.004)^n=\dfrac{4}{3}$.

$n=\dfrac{\ln\left(\frac43\right)}{\ln(1.004)}=72.06$ months, so the loan is paid completely after 73 months.
solutions.marks_breakdown: 2: finding the term of the loan from answer above; 1: working toward term of loan
